card.name: Reader-prompt questions on web pages
card.fires_on: The word "want" in the dictionary-site prompt "What made you want to look up...", and similar spots where a page turns to ask the reader a question or gives a citation line.

modes.label: Look-up prompt
modes.description: The word "want" in the encyclopedia/dictionary line asking why the reader looked up an entry.
modes.example: What made you<< want>> to look up "castrum"?

modes.label: Citation year
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after "APA citation." just before a year.

modes.label: Question to reader
modes.description: A word inside a direct question put to the reader at the end of an article.
modes.example: Do you<< ever>> have a walk after dinner?

card.writes: It favors words used when addressing a reader or forum poster, such as Chinese terms for "OP" and "do you like".
card.plain: It marks the spot where a web page stops and asks the reader a question or shows a citation line.
